request: Create 10 distinct UGC review concepts for this countertop appliance. Cover attention, consideration, trust, and conversion without repeating the same hook or hero moment.
product_context: Countertop kitchen appliance with a visible transformation process, removable parts, setup considerations, and routine-use value.
expected_behavior: Distribute concepts across attention, consideration, trust, and conversion roles.
Use multiple hook types, proof types, emotional arcs, and narrative roles.
Detect and reject concepts that differ only by dialogue wording.
critical_constraints: At least three distinct hook types should appear in a five-plus concept subset.
Do not overuse one hero feature when multiple meaningful features or objections exist.
Do not load prompt-compiler unless full generation prompts are also requested.
failure_conditions: Most concepts share the same first frame and proof order.
The campaign is effectively one concept with rewritten dialogue.
QA, performance, or model-adapter modules are loaded without a task trigger.
